enterprises.name: Meridian Mutual
enterprises.description: A mutual insurer of about 2,800 people writing motor, home, commercial property and life business in one country, founded 1911 and owned by its policyholders. Run from a head office and eleven regional agencies. Half-way through replacing a 1998 mainframe policy system with a cloud platform, one line of business at a time, while the regulator, the reinsurers and 1.4 million policyholders expect nothing to change.
enterprises.goal: Settle every straightforward claim within five working days and switch the mainframe off by the end of 2028, without a single late regulatory filing on the way.

businessCapabilities.description: Designing insurance products: cover, exclusions, terms, documents. Slow and stable, and the thing everything downstream depends on.

businessCapabilities.name: Underwriting

businessCapabilities.name: Pricing & Actuarial Modelling
businessCapabilities.description: Setting premiums from loss experience, exposure and the cost of capital; reserving for what has happened but not yet been paid.

businessCapabilities.name: Quoting

businessCapabilities.name: Policy Administration
businessCapabilities.description: Issuing, endorsing, renewing and cancelling policies. The system of record for what is insured and for how much.

businessCapabilities.name: Life & Pensions Administration
businessCapabilities.description: Long-term contracts with their own arithmetic: premiums over decades, surrenders, maturities, annuity payments.

businessCapabilities.name: Billing & Collection
businessCapabilities.description: Invoicing premiums, collecting them by direct debit or card, chasing arrears, refunding on cancellation.

businessCapabilities.name: Claims Handling

businessCapabilities.name: Fraud Detection
businessCapabilities.description: Spotting the claims and applications that are not what they say they are, before money moves.

businessCapabilities.name: Customer Service

businessCapabilities.name: Agency & Distribution Management

businessCapabilities.name: Marketing

businessProcesses.name: First notice of loss
businessProcesses.description: What happens between a policyholder reporting a loss and a handler having a registered claim. Modelled because three channels used to produce three different records.
businessProcesses.triggerEvent: A policyholder reports a loss by phone, in the app, or through an agent.
businessProcesses.outcome: A registered claim with a severity, a handler and an initial reserve.

businessProcesses.name: Motor claim assessment
businessProcesses.description: Deciding what happens to the car. The step with the repair network is where the five-day target is won or lost.
businessProcesses.triggerEvent: A registered motor claim needs a repair or total-loss decision.
businessProcesses.outcome: An approved repair, a total-loss settlement, or a rejection with reasons.

businessProcesses.name: Annual renewal run
businessProcesses.description: The nightly batch that is still the mainframe's reason to exist for home insurance.
businessProcesses.triggerEvent: A policy is 60 days from its renewal date.
businessProcesses.outcome: A renewal offer delivered, or a non-renewal notice sent.

businessProcesses.name: Quarterly solvency return
businessProcesses.description: Twelve working days from close to filing. Every step has a named owner because a late filing is a board matter.
businessProcesses.outcome: The return is filed with the supervisor before the deadline.

businessProcesses.name: Agent onboarding
businessProcesses.description: From a signed agency contract to an agent who can quote and bind.
businessProcesses.triggerEvent: A regional agency hires a new agent.
businessProcesses.outcome: The agent can quote, bind, and see their commission statements.

businessProcesses.name: Suspicious claim review
businessProcesses.description: What the Special Investigations Unit does with a flag. Kept separate from assessment so a flag never slows an honest claim.
businessProcesses.triggerEvent: The scoring model or a handler flags a claim.
businessProcesses.outcome: The claim is cleared, investigated further, or referred to the police.
